51222746.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to wild-type human full length NNMT expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3)-codonplus-RIL cells by isothermal titration calorimetry
51222746.references_previous: Reference 31: Babault, N.; Allali-Hassani, A.; Li, F.; Fan, J.; Yue, A.; Ju, K.; Liu, F.; Vedadi, M.; Liu, J.; Jin, J. Discovery of Bisubstrate Inhibitors of Nicotinamide N-Methyltransferase (NNMT). J. Med. Chem. 2018, 61, 1541–1551.

original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) measurements were performed as previously described.31 Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) was carried out at 25 °C on a MicroCal ITC200 instrument (Malvern Instruments) with 2 μL injections. NNMTwt was diluted at 200 μM in ITC buffer [50 mM Tris (pH 8.0), 150 mM NaCl] supplemented with 4% DMSO. Compounds were dissolved in DMSO at 50 mM and diluted to 2 mM in ITC buffer with a final DMSO concentration of 4%. Binding constants were calculated by fitting the data using the ITC data analysis module in Origin 7.0 (OriginLab Corp.).
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. ITC isotherms and thermograms including thermodynamic binding parameters measured for compounds 1, 66, 72, and 78 with human NNMT.
